title: The Painting Challenge
description: A dimly lit wooden desk holds a green banker's lamp, old CRT monitors, a flashlight, and a handwritten note with blood stains. The monitors display a continuous hallway scene featuring a man in a denim jacket walking away from the viewer, with one large screen showing a red digital timer reading 00:07.
prompt: A mysterious wooden desk in a dark room illuminated by a green banker's lamp, cluttered with old CRT television monitors displaying a surreal looping hallway scene of a man in a blue jacket walking away, one screen shows red digital timer 00:07, a bloody handwritten note on the desk reads 'If the painting opens, do not follow alone', flashlight, keys, mug, mysterious and unsettling atmosphere, cinematic lighting
